title: Silverheels #2 Pacific Comics 1984 Scott Hampton Bruce Jones Sci-Fi Comic Book
condition_description: Covers bright with no creases or tears. Light wear along the spine edge and a small rub on the silver logo. Staples intact. See photos.
description:
Silverheels #2 (Mar 1984), Pacific Comics - written by Bruce Jones with art by Scott Hampton. Painted cover of the hero battling red tentacles in space. Original $1.50 cover price ($2.00 in Canada).

Back cover: Alien Worlds #7 ad (Richard Corben cover).

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
